from qiskit_nature.transformers.second_quantization import ActiveSpaceTransformer
from qiskit_nature.problems.second_quantization import ElectronicStructureProblem

def vqe_n2_sto3g_cas66():
    # Set the geometry of the N₂ molecule
    molecule = Molecule(
        geometry=[["N", [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]], ["N", [0.0, 0.0, 1.098]]],
        charge=0,
        multiplicity=1,
    )

    # Use PySCF to compute the electronic structure

        atom=molecule.geometry,
        charge=molecule.charge,
        spin=molecule.multiplicity - 1,

        basis="sto3g",

    # Define the active space transformer
    active_space_transformer = ActiveSpaceTransformer(num_electrons=6, num_molecular_orbitals=6)

    # Create the electronic structure problem
    problem = ElectronicStructureProblem(driver, transformers=[active_space_transformer])

    # Convert the problem to qubit operators

    second_q_ops = problem.second_q_ops()

    # Define the optimizer

    # Define the initial state
    initial_state = None

    # Create the VQE algorithm

    # Get the ground state energy estimate

    # Reference ground state energy from literature
    reference_energy = -108.83955948592593

    # Calculate the energy error
    energy_error_against_reference = abs(ground_state_energy_estimate - reference_energy)

    # Chemical accuracy achievement
    chemical_accuracy_achievement = energy_error_against_reference < 0.001

    # Measurement cost
    measurement_cost = result.cost_function_evals

    # Qubit count
    qubit_count = qubit_ops.num_qubits

    # Circuit depth
    circuit_depth = ansatz.depth()

    # Gate count
    gate_count = sum([len(layer) for layer in ansatz.decompose().data])

    return {
        "ground_state_energy_estimate": ground_state_energy_estimate,
        "energy_error_against_reference": energy_error_against_reference,
        "chemical_accuracy_achievement": chemical_accuracy_achievement,
        "measurement_cost": measurement_cost,
        "qubit_count": qubit_count,
        "circuit_depth": circuit_depth,
        "gate_count": gate_count
    }

# Example usage
results = vqe_n2_sto3g_cas66()
